instruction: 第一台手机 Simple SMS Messenger 收到一条消息，让我去第二台手机的 Downloads 里找一张指定照片。请用第二台手机的 Android Files 检查；如果照片不在，就在该手机的 Markor 里写一条 `Photo status` 笔记，记下缺少的文件名以及来源 Simple SMS Messenger。
surfaces: android_0 Simple SMS Messenger -> android_1 Android Files app 的 Download 文件夹/Markor
evaluator_assumptions: android_1 Markor Photo status note must report the requested missing file and identify Simple SMS Messenger as its source; the body need not repeat the filename-derived note title, and final file absence is diagnostic-only
